config.covariance: LedoitWolf on source-standardized features, centered, plus 1e-6 times max(trace/d,1e-12) identity
config.coral_direction: Target-to-source: (Z_target - mu_target) @ C_target^(-1/2) @ C_source^(1/2) + mu_source. Source classifier stays in source-standardized coordinates. Reverse-direction CORAL variant, not claimed numerically identical to original source-to-target LR.
config.standardize_direction: Same target-to-source mapping with diagonal shrunk covariance; pooled calibration conditions, no labels or record IDs enter adapter
config.selection: Source GroupKFold3; simulate each validation participant as a separate target with their own prefix and common suffix. Equal-participant BA, earliest C within 1e-12 of best. Select separately for method/budget; target labels absent.
config.source_training: All 60 seconds per condition of source fit participants; no windows from inner validation participants enter source fit
config.target_access: 5/10/20 seconds are nominal per-record caps. Complete windows use 4/10/20 seconds per record, 4/10/20 pooled windows. No extra filtering; original cached windows were processed independently. All methods score the same 24-60 second suffix (36 pooled windows). Calibration and suffix are disjoint.
config.scope: Offline, known two-record boundaries with both conditions represented; not unlabeled natural-stream or online adaptation. Cached preparation/evaluator knows labels; calibration algorithm receives numeric X only.

paired_statistics.correction: Holm within the three primary comparisons; exploratory approximation because LOSO training sets overlap

permutation.unit: one binary flip per participant, shared by all windows of both conditions
permutation.test: S2 full 60s zero-calibration fixed-C LR, refit each permutation and LOSO fold; not the nested selected-C pipeline
permutation.label_independent_scalers: may cache source-only standardized arrays; model refits every permutation

umap.fit: 2100 source windows, source StandardScaler, labels only for display; transform 60 target windows

config.feature_statistics: Per-participant arithmetic-minus-rest mean DE128 for each of 57 channel-band features, paired t interval and dz, BH FDR across57; exploratory, record/order confounding remains
config.eegnet_explanation: All108 saved stage3 models; set one region to zero AFTER source channel standardization, no retraining or channel selection. Save participant/seed BA loss and predicted-score changes; average seeds within participant. Perturbations can be out of distribution and are not causal neuroanatomy. Aggregate absolute spatial weights across all filters after within-model normalization; raw filters are not aligned across seeds.
config.failure_policy: Keep all36 targets/all prescribed budgets; explicit failures, no dummy fallback or best-subject selection; incomplete sets never receive complete status

environment.compute: CPU; deterministic PyTorch; per-worker thread count in config
